bugs.title: Collections (This FY) does not equal Bank-wise receipts + Cash (₹15,000 gap)
bugs.evidence: GET /api/reports/v3/collections -> total_paise 20434866600 (₹20,43,48,666, 1,071 receipts); /bank-receipts -> total_paise 14604783900 (cleared ₹14,60,07,839 + pending ₹40,000, 881); /collections?bank=Cash -> 5831582700 (190). 881+190=1071 counts tie but ₹14,60,47,839 + ₹5,83,15,827 = ₹20,43,63,666 ≠ ₹20,43,48,666. Likely bank-wise includes the ₹40,000 pending cheque while a ₹25,000 Cash-mode 'Other' receipt (KKT/2627/39774, bank not 'Cash') is handled differently. Same gap visible on screen (finance-collections-bank-tie).

bugs.title: Bills vs Collection 'Bill raised' ≠ Customer status / Outstanding bills raised
bugs.evidence: GET /api/reports/v3/bills-vs-collection totals.demand_paise 38062956400 (₹38,06,29,564) vs /customer-status totals.bills_raised 38016979500 (₹38,01,69,795) — ₹4,59,769 apart; probably BvC includes bills of the 2 cancelled bookings or excludes something Customer status counts.

notes: Outstanding & ageing / Collections group-by offers only Project, Tower, Customer, Sales — no Floor or Flat levels (Customer status has project/tower/floor/flat/customer). Criterion asks Project → Tower → Floor → Flat → Customer. Project→Tower subtotals sum to the grand total exactly (outstanding and customer-status).

Booking register shows 82 rows (79 Active + 1 Completed + 2 Cancelled) vs 80 live bookings; non-cancelled = 80 = Customer status count. This is acceptable as a master list but the headline reads '82 bookings'.
Sales stacking-plan API rows still carry a raw customer_id UUID on 38 Sold flats (not shown on screen, no names, no money). Low risk, but consider stripping it in the display layer.
Sales hub shows only the 6 inventory tiles; lead reports return 403 for Sales (no lead tiles).
Collections list opens newest first (18 Nov 2026 rows on top), default This FY 01 Apr–18 Nov 2026.
Saved view residue: one 'QA view <ts>' preset pinned on admin's Home (created by outstanding-group-views-pin). Delete it from the Saved views menu if you don't want it there.
The localhost:3000 frontend calls the preview backend URL, so login from localhost returned 404. All browser checks ran against the preview URL.
